title: Te Pono i Whakamutu i te Kōti
intro: I roto i te whare rangatira i te wā i kingi ai te whakakahore, ā, i tino kaha te mana, i tū te huihuinga o ngā tohunga mohio ki mua i tētahi wero ohorere. I haruru te hau i te tumanako i te mea ka tata te tukinga o ngā ara e rua o te teka me te pono. Kāore i mōhio te hunga i huihui mai ka hurihia ō rātou ao ake ake e tēnei tūtakitanga, ā, ka whakairohia tō rātou kōrero ki roto i te tuhinga tapu.
clues: I rongonui mātou mō tō mātou pūkenga ki ngā mahi maminga, ā, i huihuia mātou e tētahi rangatira mana nui ki te tū atu ki tētahi kaiwhakataetae.
I te taenga mai o te wā, ka makahia e mātou ā mātou taonga puoro, ka tatari ki te hua, me te whakapono ki tā mātou mahi.
Engari nā te mea i kite mātou i meinga ā mātou ake taputapu kia rite ki ngā taonga takaro noa iho, ā, i mohio ō mātou ngākau ki te pono e kore e taea te whakakorekore.
I takoto mātou ki te whenua, me te whakapuaki i tō mātou whakapono ki te Ariki, ki a Mohi rāua ko Arona, ahakoa te riri o te rangatira.
I whakawehi mai taua rangatira i a mātou ki te whiu tino nanakia, i oati hoki ka ripekatia mātou, ka tapahia hoki ō mātou waewae ki ngā taha rerekē.
I noho pūmau mātou, me te kī he pai ake ki a mātou te whakawa a tō mātou Ariki i ngā hua o te ao, ā, i whakamatea mātou mō tō mātou whakapono.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: He whakataetae makutu ki a Mohi
He ahi i whiua ki runga i a rātou
He waipuke i toremi ai rātou
trial.answer: He whakataetae makutu ki a Mohi

options: I whakamatea mō te whakapono, i whakaaria mai te Pararaiha
I noho hei rangatira mō Īhipa
I riro i a ia te whenua
outcome.answer: I whakamatea mō te whakapono, i whakaaria mai te Pararaiha

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
